message: test(signup): add end-to-end integration test for account creation flow
post:
This past week has been a deep dive into making our application more robust and reliable, especially around core user flows and communication. We've been refining how our AI generates content, ensuring it stays grounded in the facts provided, whether that's for answering questions or crafting cover letters. This focus on accuracy and coherence is critical for building trust.

Simultaneously, we've been cleaning up our codebase, tackling a significant number of linting errors to improve maintainability. We also made a strategic move with our email infrastructure, migrating to Resend and dropping older dependencies. This not only streamlines our email sending but also allowed us to remove a potential security vulnerability related to HTML sanitization.

Finally, we've reinforced the account creation process by adding comprehensive end-to-end integration tests. This is about ensuring that when a new user signs up, that experience is as seamless and dependable as possible. We're building a foundation that can scale and perform under pressure.

How do you prioritize foundational improvements versus new feature development in your own projects?
